symbols_note: ELF flash load image exactly matches the saved application.
openocd_errors: init mode failed (unable to connect to the target)
diagnosis: ST-LINK reported target voltage 3.276 V, but OpenOCD could not connect to the target debug port. CPU, installed flash and oscillator state were not inspected.

Close other probe sessions; power-cycle the target and reconnect ST-LINK, then try D -> 3. Check SWDIO PA31, SWCLK PA30, common ground and stable target power. If it persists, a RESET/NRST wire with connect-under-reset can help recovery; the current configuration has no reset wire.
